name: sidemaid
description: Mermaid diagrams from the conversation, rendered as images in a terminal side pane

theme.title: Diagram theme
theme.description: The mermaid theme the diagrams are rendered in.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane on a new diagram
autoOpen.description: Open the pane beside the transcript when Claude writes a diagram (only where the terminal docks panes).

collapseInTranscript.title: Collapse diagrams in the transcript
collapseInTranscript.description: Draw a one-line pointer to the pane in place of each mermaid block. The conversation keeps the source either way.

promptHint.title: Tell Claude about the pane
promptHint.description: Adds a short note to the prompt: diagrams show in a pane, so write a mermaid block, top-down, with a title.

saveDir.title: Save folder
saveDir.description: Where the pane's save key writes .mmd and .png, relative to the session's working directory.

mmdcPath.title: mmdc command
mmdcPath.description: The mermaid-cli executable: a name on PATH or an absolute path.

chromePath.title: Chrome path
chromePath.description: The browser mmdc renders with. Empty: an installed Chrome or Chromium if one is found, else puppeteer's own.
